# NSPanel HAUI 0.4.4

A hotfix release: `nspanel_haui.send_notification` accepts the `timeout` field
again, so notifications can auto-dismiss after a number of seconds.

## Highlights

- **Notification `timeout` fix (#78)** — the released 0.4.3 service schema
  rejected `timeout` with "not a valid option at 'timeout'" even though the
  service documentation advertised it. The schema now accepts it (a whole
  number of seconds; `0` disables it) and the notification controller
  auto-dismisses the notification after that many seconds, closing its popup
  and advancing the queue when that popup was the one on screen. Without a
  timeout nothing auto-dismisses, so the previous behavior is unchanged.

## Notes

- The TFT display files are unchanged from 0.4.3 — panels keep their installed
  TFT until a later release updates it.
- No breaking changes; the firmware and TFT update flow is unchanged. Update
  the integration through HACS; firmware and display updates keep running
  through the **HAUI Firmware** / **HAUI Display** update entities.

## Related report

- [#78](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/78), reported by
  [@liviusefu](https://github.com/liviusefu): the `send_notification` service
  rejected `timeout` with "not a valid option" even though the builder accepted
  it. Fixed by accepting and forwarding the field and letting the controller
  auto-dismiss timed notifications.
